condition: B — structure identifiability under oracle paths
correction_applied: rho FIXED at rho_0 (formal corpus records rho* = null); no rho recovery or coverage gate; a later prior-draw calibration experiment may evaluate rho and is NOT part of this task
degenerate_summary_rule: a summary constant within every chain AND equal across chains passes trivially (R-hat := 1, ESS := n_retained); constant within chains but unequal across chains is an automatic R-hat failure
movement_rule: a chain with zero accepted H changes cannot receive a convergence PASS

pilot.selection_rule: acceptance in band -> max ESJD; else closest to band, band never widened

point_estimate_rule: posterior modal canonical H per skill (pre-registered; the 0.5-thresholded relation matrix is reported secondarily with a validity check)
proposal_family: sampler_u.propose_row symmetric Gaussian row walk; MH on Delta log p(U_k|rho_0) + Delta oracle-block log likelihood (u_row_sweep arithmetic)
rho_0_rationale: near the registered rho prior median (Uniform(0, 0.995) -> 0.4975); positive-definite Sigma with moderate column coupling; frozen before any draw
stopping_rule: two consecutive checkpoint passes; never extend beyond the ceiling automatically
u_recovery_note: raw entrywise U error is NOT a target; latent coordinates are exchangeable and the likelihood reads U only through h(U)

verdict_rule.not_converged: any convergence gate unmet after the 100k ceiling -> 'CONDITION B INFERENCE NOT CONVERGED — NO RECOVERY CLAIM'

not_identifiable_if_any.heldout: posterior-mean NLL/occ worse than the antichain baseline

verdict_rule.otherwise: STRUCTURE PARTIALLY IDENTIFIABLE UNDER ORACLE PATHS

strong_requires_all.heldout: posterior-mean NLL/occ <= antichain and <= total-order baselines AND within 0.05 nats/occ of generating truth
